name_note: GTDB places this species in Lachnospira, while the genomes carry the NCBI names [Lactobacillus] rogosae and Lachnospira pectinoschiza; the brackets mark a name whose placement in Lactobacillus is not accepted.

sentences.text: Lactobacillus rogosae, named by Holdeman and Moore in 1974, is not currently represented by an extant type strain, and existing strains are not available in any established culture collection.
The matter was referred to the Judicial Commission, which stated that further work is needed to find a derivative of the original type or to designate a neotype.

A study that sequenced 66 stool samples from Angolan children with sickle cell anaemia reported higher proportions of short-chain fatty acid producing species, including Lactobacillus rogosae, after six months of hydroxyurea.

Genomes placed in this species are also deposited as Lachnospira pectinoschiza, which an in vitro fermentation study with pig colonic digesta described as a pectinolytic microbe stimulated by citrus pectin.
